generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
heavy: This file is large: processing may be slow or fail on this device.

encrypted.title: This file is password-protected.
encrypted.action: Unlock it first with the “Unlock” tool, then try again.

bad-password.title: That password is not correct.
bad-password.action: Check your typing (capitals, spaces) and try again.

damaged.title: This file looks damaged or is not a valid PDF.
damaged.action: Try downloading it again, or open and re-save it from another application.

memory.title: This device does not have enough memory for this file.
memory.action: Close other tabs, process fewer pages at once, or try on a computer.

empty.title: There is nothing to produce with these settings.
empty.action: Check the page or file selection.

unsupported.title: This browser does not offer this feature.
unsupported.action: Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

unknown.title: Processing failed.
unknown.action: Try again. If the problem persists, the file may use a PDF feature that is not supported.
